sentence_stem: Not only had the editor rejected the article,
correct_completion: but she had also demanded a complete rewrite.
full_sentence: Not only had the editor rejected the article, but she had also demanded a complete rewrite.
acceptable_variants: but she also insisted on major revisions.
and she even postponed the whole issue.

options.text: the article was published the next morning.
options.why_wrong: Publication does not complete the 'not only ... but also' pattern, which requires a parallel additional action by the same subject.

options.text: so the author withdrew the piece.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, not the additive second element that 'not only' requires.
'Although' signals concession, which conflicts with the additive structure set up by 'not only'.

options.text: but she had also demanded a complete rewrite.

grammar_focus: Correlative 'not only ... but also' with parallel clauses and inversion after 'not only'
explanation: After 'not only' with inversion, the sentence needs a second clause that adds a further action by the same subject, introduced by 'but also'. Learners should keep the subject and tense consistent across both halves.
translation: Редакторка не лише відхилила статтю, а й вимагала повністю її переписати.
